Then we need to start engine with standard start mode. The tool startEngine expects ignitionMode: "START" or "STOP". So we pass "START".

Thus we need to call liter_to_gallon with liter=150. Then call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount=40. Then call startEngine with ignitionMode="START".

We also might want to check the current fuel level? Not necessary. Just fill.

We need to call the functions in order. We'll call liter_to_gallon first. Then fillFuelTank. Then startEngine.
